title: Adaptive regional congestion thermostat and token-latency attribution estimator
creator: Asha Banerjee
description: Build an orchestration and instrumentation blueprint that (1) computes a per-region congestion 'thermostat' (a single numeric headroom estimate driving adaptive client-side and server-side shedding), and (2) provides a token-latency attribution estimator to map slow tails to causal subsystems (decode, kv-cache, kernel-prep, network). This ticket covers metric derivation, Prometheus/OTel instrumentation spec, prototype aggregator for region-level headroom, and Grafana dashboard panels for SREs and on-call to make fast failover and shed decisions.
acceptance_criteria: A headroom metric (0..1) computed per region is emitted at 30s cadence and stored in metrics backend
Token-latency estimator pipeline ingests per-token timing spans and emits breakdowns (decode vs kv-hit vs scheduling) for p50/p90/p99
Grafana dashboard with summary row, heatmap across regions, and drilldown panels for top contributing subsystems is available
Automated alert rules for headroom < 0.15 in two regions or decreasing rapidly (slope threshold) are in place
Documentation and runbook describing how thermostat maps to circuit thresholds and emergency manual overrides are published
technical_notes: Thermostat will be computed from blended signals: admit_rate/utilization, queueing latency, KV hit-rate, and GPU utilization. Use EWMA to smooth short spikes.

Prefer vector-derived Prometheus rules where possible; for heavy per-token pipelines use OTel traces exported to an aggregation service to compute attribution offline and emit derived metrics back into Prometheus/Grafana via pushgateway.
Token-level estimator uses sampled-span enrichment: add 'phase' tags (ingress, decode, kv-lookup, kernel, egress) and correlate by request_id + token_index where available.
To avoid cardinality explosion, bucket token_index into prefix/continuation groups and sample 1:100 requests with full per-token spans; aggregate histograms rather than raw timings.
Candidate thresholds for map: thermostat <0.25 -> soft-shed (increase early-exit probability), <0.12 -> hard-shed (reject lower priority), <0.05 -> route to fallback model/region
proposed_dashboard_panels: Regional headroom summary row (sparkline per region, current value, trend slope)
Headroom heatmap: regions x 1h buckets showing percent of time in each headroom bin
Token-latency attribution stacked bars (p50/p90/p99) split by subsystem
Top failing customer routes correlated with headroom dips (table with recent incidents)
Admission vs shed decisions timeline overlayed with thermostat and capacity changes
Sampler detail panel: sampled trace waterfall viewer with per-token phase timings
comments: 2026-02-16 - Asha Banerjee: Kickoff meeting notes attached in Confluence. Primary goal is to reduce time-to-detect sustained regional congestion and provide an actionable single-value control for autoscaling and shedding.

2026-02-20 - Daniel Park: Prototype aggregator emitting 'region_headroom' metric at 30s cadence. Initial formula: 1 - normalize(admit_rate_threshold / observed_admit_rate) * 0.5 - gpu_util_norm * 0.3 - kv_miss_penalty * 0.2. Needs normalization tuning.
2026-02-25 - Sofia Martinez (SRE): Request to include queue-length percentile and request fanout factor into headroom; otherwise optimizer may overestimate capacity when queueing hides the true load.
2026-03-02 - Daniel Park: Implemented sampled-span tags for 'phase' and added histogram buckets. Sampling set to 1% in prod for now, with a temporary job to backfill 24h at 10% for validation.
2026-03-05 - Security review (info): no sensitive PII emitted in traces; ensure sampled traces are redacted for prompt contents per privacy guidelines. Added masking step.
2026-03-08 - Design review: Dashboard mockups approved with minor layout changes; agreed to prioritize summary row and heatmap for on-call UX.
2026-03-10 - Daniel Park: Prepared alert prototypes; requesting SRE signoff on slope thresholds and alert noise budget. Next: integrate thermostat into canary shed controller PR.
